architecture.name: cqrs
architecture.rule: Query components are responsible for reading data.
Repository components are responsible for mutating persisted data.
No other application component should directly query or mutate database data.

queries.rule: Queries should contain only database-read logic.

repositories.rule: Repositories should only handle ORM operations or execute SQL and return the resulting data.
Repositories should not know about DTOs.
Repositories should return data in the form appropriate to the persistence layer.
Repositories should not contain business logic.

services.rule: Services are responsible for coordinating persistence operations.
Services use Queries to read data.
Services use Repositories to mutate data.
Services are responsible for committing database changes when the project's transaction model requires service-level commits.
Services should return DTOs at application boundaries when DTOs are part of the project design.
